How to say no to a client politely, with one AI prompt

A client asks for one more revision, this week, same price. You're fully booked. Here's the prompt I use to answer in seconds instead of stewing over it.

Copy this:

"Help me say no politely. The request: [PASTE IT]. My reason: [ONE LINE]. What I can offer instead: [ALTERNATIVE, OR NOTHING]. 3 sentences max. Warm, clear, no over-apologizing."

What came back on my example: a thank-you, the reason in one line, and an offer for next Tuesday at the usual rate. Firm, friendly, done.

Two rules: keep the reason to one line, and offer one alternative or none. "No" is a full answer.

Send this to someone who still says yes to everything. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.
